scope: Latest-generation <=2B text-only local model screening. Eight exposed development probes plus sixteen previously frozen and ungenerated probes; diagnostic paired comparison, no held-out model selection.
modelSelection: Latest Qwen3.5 eligible text GGUF bundles; actual tensor elements <=2000000000 before inference. No older Qwen or4B inference.
review: Personally inspect every raw output and preserved cleanup; source fact/condition/negation/state/request fidelity, natural scene structure, required repairs and harmful OCR. Native startup and resident request latency separate; no claim of low-end hardware acceptance or cross-runtime causality.

inputProvenance.gold: expectations.json only evaluated after inference; never sent to model
